event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: TUR 2206 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The written protest did neither include the protestor nor any description of an incident between boats
conclusions: The protest did not identify the protestor and incident, as required by RRS 60.3(a). Therefore, the protest is invalid under RRS 60.4(a)(1)
decision: Since the protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
